caption:
🎙️ @carter.welling and @russellmnelson 

Following a victory in January 2026, @clemsonmbb player and @churchofjesuschrist member, Carter Welling, gave a phenomenally polite answer in response to a question on how he feels about someone in the crowd wearing a “Mormon Missile” t-shirt.

In October 2018, @russellmnelson gave a talk at General Conference that explained why using the correct name of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints is so important. 

“What’s in a name or, in this case, a nickname? When it comes to nicknames of the Church, such as the “LDS Church,” the “Mormon Church,” or the “Church of the Latter-day Saints,” the most important thing in those names is the absence of the Savior’s name. To remove the Lord’s name from the Lord’s Church is a major victory for Satan. When we discard the Savior’s name, we are subtly disregarding all that Jesus Christ did for us�—even His Atonement.”

athlete.bio: A strategic force on defense, this linebacker blends relentless tenacity with sharp instincts. Hailing from a small town, he embodies grit and determination, inspiring teammates both on and off the field.

caption:
It’s not what you get from playing this game it’s what you become

This is a post that’s hard to put into words because how much this place means to me.
This August after a fall camp scrimmage I got to my phone in the locker room. My phone was blown up from my parents, pastors, and friends. The first text I read was “call me immediately” - Dad 
I sprint back onto the practice field and called him. He said that my younger brother Brooks was in a terrible biking accident and was being rushed to the hospital. I immediately clasped to the ground on all fours. We thought that he would be paralyzed and I lost it. Then I felt 4 hands on my back. Brodey, Clay, Trent, Jason LeMay. Right there in that moment they laid hands on me and prayed for Brooks. God heard those prayers. Brooks is not paralyzed and will make a full recovery. Gods hands were on Brooks. 
Over the next days and weeks I did not turn a corner in the facility without someone asking about Brooks. I had hundreds of people reach out to me praying for my younger brother. We prayed for Brooks in the team meeting in the meeting rooms and on the practice field. This is what team is and what this program means to me. 
You don’t see this place truly until it’s your last time. I will never forget the memories and relationships I’ve made. The days are long but the years are short. I owe everything to the people and these place. Thank you @clemsonfb 
“For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control” - 2 Tim 1:7

Join us in welcoming Clemson Softball Player Kylee Johnson to the Pilates Social family! 🤎✨🦋 She is a powerhouse on the field, and ACC All-Academic Team and ACC Honor Roll to boot! 🙌

Kylee: “What I love most about Pilates Social is how caring and giving they are. The way they give back through supporting pediatric cancer truly shows the kindness in the hearts of the PS team! Pilates has become my escape from reality, where I can challenge myself and enjoy a new hobby I’ve come to love! I have noticed significant differences in my mobility and recovery since starting Pilates! It has allowed my body to feel refreshed and ready to perform at practice or in games!”

Kylee has become a regular in our studio and it shows in her improvement, strength, mobility, and flexibility. Reformer Pilates helps softball players build powerful core strength, improve balance and mobility, and prevent injuries. By training stability, rotation, and control, it directly supports stronger swings, faster throws, quicker reactions, and better recovery on the field. We are thrilled to be part of Kylee’s journey, and we just love her! 🥎

athlete.bio: A tenacious Pin Attacker with a fierce competitive spirit, she blends agility and finesse, captivating crowds with her precise strikes and relentless energy. Off the court, her humor and charisma shine.

caption:
To the shy little girl who didn’t want to go to her first volleyball practice, but her mom made her - look how far you have come. 17 years of playing the sport I love has finally come to an end. 

Its crazy how fast time can fly and you dont even realize it. Through all the blood, sweat, and tears its time to hangup the Jersey to move on to the next chapter of my life.

I am so grateful to everyone who has been apart of this journey and the people I have met along the way, the memories that will last a lifetime, blessing me with some of my best friends but most importantly the way this sport has shaped me to be the woman I am today. 

Being able to play this sport has been the biggest blessing of my life and I can only thank God for getting me to where I am today. It wasn’t always easy, there were many challenges along the way but it was all apart of HIS plan. 

Thank you Clemson for the best 4 years of my life and thank you Volleyball for the best 17.  To the end of an era ❤️‍🩹 #22out

Pilates Social is proud to have Clemson Football Player Christian Bentancur on our team! 🙌 

The impressive Tight End - selected to be a Pilates Social Student-Athlete Ambassador a few months ago because of his character - has become a regular in our studio.

Christian: “I really like how Pilates Social focuses on your form and overall body awareness. It has helped me a lot in football by improving my core strength, mobility, and balance, which has made me feel stable and more explosive. My goal with Pilates is to build a stronger and more flexible foundation that helps me stay without injuries and perform at the highest level on the field.”

Christian has put in the hard work with our incredibly knowledgeable instructors and it shows! He had a touchdown against Furman after a multi-touchdown game at North Carolina in October. His core strength, balance, and precision are 🔥. We are not going to say it was ONLY the Pilates, but Pilates is definitely part of the secret sauce! 🧘‍♀️🏈

caption:
Join us in giving Clemson Gymnast SIERRA CHURCH the warmest Pilates Social welcome as she joins our PS family as a Student Athlete Ambassador!! 🤸

Sierra: “Pilates Social is such an amazing atmosphere where it challenges me in many ways but still is so fun and supportive by bringing each other up! These workouts help me gain strength, flexibility, and control in my body that will help me in gymnastics. I’m so grateful to be a part of this positive and empowering community!!” 

Hometown: Lincolnton, NC 
Major: Psychology

The best way we can describe Sierra is a bright light! She brings such positivity and sunshine into the studio with her big smile and amazing energy. Reformer Pilates has helped Sierra get stronger and improve her core strength and flexibility, essential for mastering complex routines and maintaining balance during high-intensity movements. The focused, controlled exercises enhance body alignment and posture, which directly translate to better form and performance on beam and bars. Additionally, Pilates strengthens stabilizing muscles, reducing injury risk and allowing for faster recovery, keeping her in top shape for consistent training. We love supporting Sierra through her collegiate journey and can’t wait to see her hard work pay off! 🤎✨🦋

caption: You always hear that you want to leave the jersey in a better place and that was always the goal each day I put it on. You soon realize how privileged you are to suit up everyday and play your favorite kids game. Looking back on it all, there’s not a thing I would change. There were countless ups and downs but that opened doors that I never would have thought existed. I am grateful for my time in the game and what it taught me but most of all I’m thankful for the people I met along the way. I’m thankful for the love and support from those that always had belief and thankful for the opportunities that I was given. I’ve learned so much from this game and maybe one day I can give it back. I owe so much to a game that at the time felt like gave me nothing in return. So as this chapter ends, and another one begins, I leave the game knowing I gave it every ounce I had and appreciating everything it returned. Thank you baseball for letting this kid live out his dream each day and thank you for bringing me so much joy for 21 years. ❤️

The Journey Continues… at CLEMSON🧡💜🐾

I’m beyond excited to announce that I’ve officially signed with Clemson University on a full athletic scholarship to continue both my gymnastics and academic journey!

This is a new challenge, a new opportunity and a new chance to grow, to experience even more from the sport I love and to live out a dream I’ve always had. 
I couldn’t feel more grateful for what’s ahead.
I’m excited to show everyone what it’s like being a student athlete.
The decision to leave Germany wasn’t an easy one but sometimes change is exactly what you need. I’m so grateful for the path in the national team 🇩🇪 that led me here and can’t wait for what’s next. 🇺🇸

Thank you to my amazing coaches in Chemnitz, my family and my friends for always believing in me and standing by my side. 

Clemson feels like the right place to grow, learn, and become the best version of myself, both as an athlete and as a person.

The dream is coming to life.
Let’s go Tigers! 🐅🧡💜

athlete.name: Holden Caspersen
athlete.bio: A relentless strategist on the field, this long snapper thrives under pressure, delivering precision with every snap. Off the gridiron, his humor and camaraderie foster a tight-knit team atmosphere.

caption:
Holden Caspersen
Clemson University 

Clemson senior long snapper, Holden Caspersen, came out to Nashville for a two day session. Holden has mainly been Clemson’s long snapper on field goals and PAT’s (a very solid short snapper) and wanted to get some training/coaching on protection and blocking technique. Clemson is predominantly in a free release punt scheme but introducing protection is important and vital to his development. Holden wants to be able to display the ability to block and prepare himself. 

In day 1, we assessed and introduced ball drills, footwork and hand placement. He adapted quickly and was able to pick up each drill quickly. 

In day 2, we built off of the previous day, added more live rushes and put all the drills to work. Holden became more confident, comfortable and efficient. For never really being asked to block or work on protection, he did a fantastic job! 

Holden is a proven college vet, the type of leader you want in your specialist room, very reliable and a great young man. I look forward to helping him refine, develop and grow into the snapper he strives to be. Thank you to you and your mom, Amy, for making the trip and taking time out of your summer to come work. Truly grateful!

STAY READY 🤟

I want to study sports medicine and feel that Clemson, with their cutting edge facilities and sports med program, will be a great fit and I look forward to learning and growing academically and reaching all the goals I’ve set for myself as a gymnast at Clemson. I have spent the past 20 years of my life playing this game, and along the way have met countless people and made thousands of memories that I will be forever grateful for. Thank you to all of my teammates, coaches, institutions, and opponents for giving me the opportunity to play this game for so long. I’ve learned along that way that it’s not the experience itself that you will remember… it’s those who endure it with you that you will remember. There is no feeling in the world like taking the field with your best friends. I will forever credit the game of baseball for teaching me about life and the importance of consistent work ethic.

5 out ✌️

caption: Wes, how can I begin to describe the impact you had on everyone you met. Wes and I met in 3rd grade playing baseball and quickly became great friends. We grew closer through middle school and high school and college and stayed close through it all despite going to school 900 miles apart. I had no idea what to do when I first heard what happened because there was no way that could be real. Then I got a call to confirm and absolutely broke down. How could such evil choose such a target as Wes? Always been the light and the energy of the room no matter where or how big. Always treated people in the best way possible. Always brightened up the room with his jokes and his laugh.  I know God has a plan for good to come through this wickedness, but it is hard to see. Psalm 27 has been on my heart since around March and I feel led to share part of it. Psalm 27:13-14 says, “I am certain that I will see the LORD’s goodness in the land of the living. Wait for the LORD; be strong, and let your heart be courageous. Wait for the LORD.”
